STRICT 15-SECOND STRUCTURE Every video must be exactly 15 seconds and must deliver a complete beginning, escalation, reveal, emotional reaction, and final payoff. Recommended timeline: 0:00–0:02.5 — Immediate Luxury Hook Open directly on the extraordinary luxury arrival. Camera rules: Vertical 9:16 Strict 15 seconds iPhone rear-camera appearance Camera operator never visible Phone never visible No selfie perspective No visible tripod No camera rig No microphone No reflection of the recorder No drone unless specifically requested No professional camera crew No multiple impossible angles No sudden teleportation No artificial orbit shots No perfect stabilization No dramatic crane movement No slow motion No lens flares No artificial depth-of-field blur No rapid music-video cuts Prefer one continuous handheld shot whenever possible.
